## Overview

This presentation concerns Chapter 8 of *A Course on Large Deviations with an Introduction to Gibbs Measures*.

The presentation develops the thermodynamic-limit framework and the subsequent material on Gibbs measures and variational structure.

## Planned contents

- Finite-volume Gibbs models
- Energy as a spatial sum
- Thermodynamic pressure
- Thermodynamic limits
- The transition from Section 8.1 to Section 8.2
